gui_forms::GroupBox.summary: GroupBox is a titled Panel specialization with validated typography, mnemonic focus routing, caption-aware border painting, and group semantics.
remarks: Adds caption text and font over `Panel`, with mnemonic focus routing and caption-aware border painting.
Radio grouping uses logical retained containers; full caption-aware child layout remains later work.
gui_forms::GroupBox.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::GroupBox.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::GroupBox.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
